messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: tag release/2.7.1 -> prod-us-west (targets: runtime-api, router). Commit: abc1234. Change window: 2026-03-20 02:00-03:00 UTC. Strategy: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%.

maya: Noted. Any DB migrations or config flags to be aware of?

deploy-bot: No DB migrations. Config only: CACHE_TTL reduced from 300 -> 60s for runtime-api.

sam: I'll watch SLO dashboards and traces for the canary.

deploy-bot: Canary at 5%: health-checks OK, all pods Ready, no errors in logs so far.

oncall-bot: ALERT: runtime-api service experiencing 502 spike (02:07:23 UTC) — error_rate=12% over 60s, rolling 5xx spikes on pod runtime-api-7f9c.

maya: I see rising p95 latency as well. Halting rollout. @deploy-bot please abort canary and rollback.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by maya. Reverting to tag release/2.6.9 (commit def5678). Reason: runtime-api 502 spike during canary. Estimated rollback time ~4m.

jordan: Please pin release/2.6.9 on prod-us-west and set route fallback to pinned version until postmortem. I'll open an incident ticket.

deploy-bot: Executing revert command:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime-api --to-revision=42
kubectl rollout status deployment/runtime-api -n prod-us-west
```

deploy-bot: Rollback completed at 02:12:02 UTC. Active tag now release/2.6.9. Pin applied: prod-us-west -> release/2.6.9. Health-checks: passing.

sam: Verification: error_rate <1%, p95 latency back to baseline. Good to pin.

deploy-bot: Revert-deploy completed and pinned. Snapshot metrics attached to the rollout note. Initiating automated quiet period on auto-rollouts for 30m.

maya: I'll create INC-4521 (postmortem) with canary traces, pod logs, and recent kube events. Assigning to eng-runtime.

sam: +1 on the postmortem. We should include the canary traffic sample and the exact pod that produced 5xx.

jordan: Thanks everyone — leaving the pin in place until we have a fix and a validation plan. We'll plan a re-roll in the next approved change window.
